source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of bridging the digital divide (PDF 184-185).

blocks.text: Digital divide ko bridge karne (faasla kam karne) ka matlab hai yeh pakka karna ke har shakhs ko technology aur internet ka barabar access (pohanch) ho. Yeh is liye zaroori hai ke sab ko seekhne aur aage barhne ke ek jaise mauqe milein. Is ke kuch tareeqe yeh hain:

items: Government Initiatives (hukumat ke qadam ya programs): Hukumat un ilaqon mein internet ke liye zaroori infrastructure (towers, cables jaisa bunyadi dhancha) bana sakti hai jahan yeh nahi hai. Misal: Pakistan mein Universal Service Fund (USF) un dehaat aur remote (bohat door ke) ilaqon tak internet pohanchane ka kaam karta hai jahan logon ko pehle access nahi tha.

Educational Programs (taleemi programs): School aur community centers logon ko technology istemal karna sikha sakte hain. Misal: Digital literacy programs students aur bare logon ko parhai aur rozmarra kaamon ke liye computer aur internet istemal karna sikhate hain.

Public-Private Partnerships (hukumat aur private companies ka mil kar kaam): Jab hukumat businesses aur nonprofits (aisi organizations jo munafa kamane ke liye nahi, madad ke liye kaam karti hain) ke saath mil kar kaam karti hai to technology ko sasta (affordable) bana sakti hai. (Kitab is tareeqe ki misal nahi deti.)

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Pakistan ki hukumat ne rural (dehaati) ilaqon mein internet ka access barhane ke liye kai initiatives (qadam ya programs) shuru kiye hain, jin mein remote (bohat door ke) ilaqon mein mobile broadband services shuru karna bhi shamil hai. In koshishon ke bawajood kai ilaqon mein ab bhi reliable (bharose wala, har waqt chalne wala) internet connection nahi, jo batata hai ke digital divide kam karna ab bhi ek jari challenge hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Apni community (ilaqe) ke bare mein sochein. Kya wahan aise log hain jinhein internet ya digital devices ka access nahi? Un ki madad ke liye kya kiya ja sakta hai? Ek chhota paragraph likhein ke aap ka school ya community digital divide kam karne mein kaise madad kar sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Digital divide ko bridge karne ka matlab samjhaiye, aur Pakistan ki misalon ke saath government initiatives ka role (kaam aur hissa) bataiye. (Long question 2)
blocks.explanation: Digital divide bridge karne ka matlab hai ke sab ko technology aur internet ka barabar access mile, ta ke sab ko seekhne aur aage barhne ke ek jaise mauqe milein. Hukumat ka role sab se ahem hai, kyunke woh un ilaqon mein infrastructure bana sakti hai jahan internet nahi. Pakistan ki misalein: Universal Service Fund (USF) dehaat aur remote ilaqon tak internet services pohanchata hai, aur hukumat ne remote ilaqon mein mobile broadband services shuru ki hain. Hukumat digital literacy programs aur businesses aur nonprofits ke saath mil kar kaam (public-private partnerships) ke zariye technology sasti bhi kar sakti hai. Kitab ke mutabiq in koshishon ke bawajood kai ilaqon mein ab bhi reliable connection nahi, is liye yeh kaam jari rehna chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity: Aap ka school ya community digital divide kam karne mein kaise madad kar sakti hai? Ek chhota paragraph likhein.
blocks.explanation: Misal ke taur par (apne ilaqe ke mutabiq likhein): school ki computer lab chhutti ke din walidain aur parosiyon ke liye khol sakte hain; bare students bari umar ke logon aur doosron ko phone aur internet ki bunyadi baatein sikha sakte hain; aur purane computer ya phone theek kar ke un khandanon ko de sakte hain jin ke paas device nahi.

items: Bridging: sab ko technology aur internet ka barabar access.
Tareeqe: government initiatives (USF), educational programs (digital literacy), public-private partnerships (sasti technology).
